annotations.title: SEC 10-K internal controls & material weakness check

description: SEC 10-K internal controls & material weakness check — Internal-control health from a US public company's latest (or earlier, filing 0-4) Form 10-K on SEC EDGAR (Item 9A and the auditor's report). Returns management's conclusion on disclosure controls and on internal control over financial reporting (EFFECTIVE / NOT_EFFECTIVE), whether a material weakness is disclosed, still open or remediated (with the quoted statements and remediation steps), the auditor's ICFR attestation (AUDITOR_ATTESTED / ADVERSE / NONE for exempt filers), any change-in-controls statement, and a verdict EFFECTIVE / MATERIAL_WEAKNESS / REMEDIATED / UNCLEAR. Risk-factor wording about possible future weaknesses is ignored. Use it for audit, credit, short-seller and governance screens and pairs with sec/auditor and sec/going-concern. ticker: stock ticker or CIK (e.g. SMCI). filing: optional, 0 = latest 10-K (default) up to 4. Source: SEC EDGAR (public domain). Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_internal_controls
